brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level fabric string is 'Recycled polyester Greensphere (matte woven) with TPU-welded seams on Extreme waterproof line'. This holds for 5 of 6 products reviewed: Top-Tube Frame Bag Venture EXTREME Waterproof ('100% Waterproof recycled polyester', glossy dimpled TPU-laminate texture in every photo, magnetic seal - the Extreme/TPU-welded case the string describes); Tube Frame Bag Venture S 3L ('Green Sphere material: Recycled Polyester', DWR, YKK zip, 'Waterproof: No' - correctly the NON-extreme matte case); Handlebar Bag Venture 17L ('100% recycled polyester' Green Sphere with Hypalon reinforcement); AGU Essential Pannier ('100% recycled 600D polyester with PU coating', 'Hexagon ribstop with PU coating', Green Sphere); AGU Urban Essentials DWR Pannier ('Green Sphere material: recycled water-repellent Polyester'). The ONE exception found: the only live 'Seat-Pack Venture' page reachable (colourway 'Steel Blue Canvas') lists 'Materials/Fabric: 100% Organic Cotton' with a taped waterproof Dryliner lining - COTTON, not recycled polyester Greensphere at all. The product name itself flags this ('Seat-Pack Venture Steel Blue CANVAS Steel Blue') - AGU appears to run a cotton-canvas sub-variant of the Venture Seat-Pack alongside a standard polyester one, and the canvas variant is the only one whose spec page I could reach; other colourways of the same model (Black, Army Green etc.) may well be the standard Greensphere polyester the brand string describes. Flagged rather than assumed either way.
brand_notes.method: agu.com is a Magento storefront; curl with a desktop UA returns full server-rendered HTML including a 'Product properties' table with a raw 'Product Dimensions' field (no unit or axis labels) for products that have one - two of six products (Tube Frame Bag Venture S/3L, and the general 'seatpack-venture' URL passed by the brief) return HTTP 404/no dimensions at all; for the frame bag, no dimensions are published anywhere on agu.com for the S/3L variant specifically, only Item Numbers and a volume picker. Two products (Top-Tube Frame Bag Venture Extreme Waterproof, Handlebar Bag Venture) needed the /eu/ or full-slug URL rather than the /en/ or /eu/<short-slug> URL the brief gave, which 404'd; found the working slugs via web search. The KlickFix pannier and Urban DWR pannier are not sold on agu.com in a form I could reach directly and were read from a third-party retailer (tradeinn.com) and agu.com respectively; product photos for all six came from agu.com's Magento media/catalog/product CDN paths, found the same way as the dimensions.

products.name: AGU Venture Seat-Pack
products.dims_raw: AGU product-properties table, 'Product Dimensions': '10 x 15 x 50' (no unit given, no axis labels; cm and W x H x L assumed, consistent with the existing catalogue record). Volume Bag (liter): 10. Maximum load bicycle bag: 6.0kg. Product weight: 512g.
products.dims_note: Single figure, not a range - the new unfurled/min-height rule has nothing to choose between here. AGU does not label which number is which axis; kept the existing catalogue mapping (wid=10, hgt=15, len=50) since it reads as W x H x L and the product photo confirms a long, narrow, tapered-wedge seatpack shape consistent with a 50cm nose-to-tail run on a 10cm width. Box 50x10x15 = 7.5L against 10L rated (ratio 0.75), plausible for a tapered wedge that doesn't fill its own bounding box.

geometry.notes: Classic Apidura-style tapered saddle wedge: wide, flat-topped shoulder clamped at the saddle rails, narrowing to a rolled, buckled tail. Criss-crossed reflective bungee lacing across the top of the nose section for stashing small items on top.

closure.hardware: single side-release buckle plus a drawcord/toggle at the tail roll

pockets.note: criss-crossed reflective bungee lacing, per maker copy 'Smart elastic bands provide an extra temporary storage on top of the pack'

details.reflective: 3M reflective details on the bungee lacing and strap ends
details.seams: taped waterproof lining ('Dryliner Technology: water-repellent outer layer with a taped waterproof lining')
details.fabric: 100% Organic Cotton (this Steel Blue Canvas colourway) - does NOT match brands.json's Greensphere-polyester brand string; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Strap-mounted, not a rigid hanger - the two nose straps clamp the rails and a lower strap braces the post. clearance is a visual estimate, not measured.

products.name: AGU Top-Tube Frame Bag Venture Extreme Waterproof
products.dims_raw: AGU product page: '21 x 11 x 6 centimeters', 0.7 liters, 125 grams. Item number 41503401-000.
products.dims_note: SLOT CHECK (audit-slots flagged this name as implying framebag_full/framebag_half): confirmed toptube is CORRECT by the on-bike photo (41503401_000_sphere_01_3.jpg) - it is a small flap-top pouch sitting entirely on the top tube just behind the head tube, nowhere near frame-triangle size; 'Top-Tube Frame Bag' is just AGU's own naming pattern for products that attach to the top tube of the frame, not a claim that it fills the triangle. slot_should_be left null. Single published figures, no range, so the unfurled/min-height rule has nothing to pick between. Ratio 11/6=1.83 (against a 2.0 elongation threshold some earlier passes used, since removed per HANDOVER.md), consistent with the broad, low, flat-topped wedge visible in every photo - wid=11 (across the top tube) and hgt=6 (shallow) is deliberately NOT swapped to the more typical narrow-and-tall arrangement.

geometry.notes: Small, low, broad wedge with a diagonal flap lid (glossy TPU-laminate 'carbon-look' texture in every photo) tapering slightly toward the front tip where the drawcord pull sits.

closure.hardware: one-handed magnetic snap under the flap, plus a drawcord/toggle pull at the front tip

details.seams: welded (glossy TPU-laminate face visible in every photo, consistent with a welded waterproof construction)
details.fabric: 100% waterproof recycled polyester (TPU-laminate face) - matches brands.json's Extreme/TPU-welded clause; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Two velcro straps around the top tube just behind the head tube, confirmed in the on-bike photo; AGU's generic copy also mentions stem/seatpost mounting but the photographed product sits on the top tube only.

products.name: AGU Tube Frame Bag Venture (S, 3L)
products.dims_raw: No dimensions are published anywhere on the maker page for this product - only a volume picker (3L / 4L / 5.5L, item numbers 415036 / 415038 / 415040) and no size chart entry (the page's 'Sizechart' tab is the generic clothing size chart, not bag dimensions). No third-party listing with the S/3L dimensions was found either.
products.dims_note: UNVERIFIED - dims_cm left UNCHANGED from the existing catalogue record per the spec's 'do not invent' rule; there is no maker or retailer source for these three numbers for the 3L size specifically, only for the product's shape (below), which comes from a photo of the 5.5L (L) variant, the size actually pictured on the page. Geometry/hardware description below is evidence-backed even though the exact numbers are not; do not treat this record's dims as more solid than the flag indicates.

geometry.notes: Photographed on the L/5.5L variant (415040), same family shape expected at S: a long, low, wedge-shaped frame-triangle sliver, wide at one end and tapering to a near point at the other, with a single long diagonal YKK zip running most of its length and a small pull loop at the narrow end.

closure.hardware: single water-resistant YKK zipper running most of the panel's length

details.fabric: Green Sphere recycled polyester, DWR-coated, not waterproof-rated - matches brands.json's non-Extreme Greensphere clause; see brand_notes.fabric
details.note: modular velcro strap system - maker copy: 'the straps can be secured in the desired locations'; a hydration-tube port is built into the main compartment

mount.notes: Four velcro loop tabs along the top edge (3 visible along the top, 1 at the lower front corner in the photo) lace it into the front triangle; exact tube contacts at the 3L size are inferred from the family shape, not measured.

products.name: AGU Handlebar Bag Venture 17L
products.dims_raw: AGU product page: '65 x 15 x 15 cm', 17 liters, 420g.
products.dims_note: Single figure, no range published, and the on-bike photo (415032_model_11_1.jpg) shows a clean cylindrical roll with both ends tightly buckled - reads as the as-mounted packed size already, not an unfurled flat panel, so used directly as len (across the bars) / wid=hgt (diameter). Box (cylinder) pi*(7.5)^2*65 = 11.5L against 17L rated (ratio 0.68), a bit loose but plausible for a soft-sided roll that isn't a perfect cylinder end to end.

geometry.notes: Straight barrel roll, buckled at both ends, mounted between the drops. Hexagon-textured reinforcement panel on the body.

closure.hardware: side-release buckle at each end of the roll

straps.note: 'spacers guarantee enough space between the bag and the headset with cables' per maker copy - a lower strap/spacer bracing down toward the head tube, visible in the on-bike photo

details.reflective: 3M reflection; the 'Reflective Mist' colourway has a full reflective overall print
details.fabric: 100% recycled polyester Green Sphere with Hypalon reinforcement at strategic wear points - matches brands.json fabric string; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Spacer/strap system holds the bag proud of the headset and cables per maker copy. clearance is a rough estimate, not measured.

products.name: AGU Essential Pannier Rack Bag
products.dims_raw: Retailer spec (tradeinn.com, reproducing the AGU listing): '34 x 28 x 16 cm', 12 litres, 430g, max load 10kg. Mounts 'by means of KLICKfix Vario Top hooks (o 8-16mm)'.
products.dims_note: Inherits the SLOT + AXIS fix already on record for this product (was catalogued as slot 'trunk' with len34/wid28/hgt16 transposed; corrected to slot 'pannier' with len28/hgt34/wid16). Independently confirmed by the on-bike photo (essential-4.webp): a portrait-format flap-top bag, clearly TALLER than it is long/wide, hanging beside the rear wheel from two KLICKfix hooks on the back panel - exactly a pannier silhouette, not a rack-top trunk box. Single figure, not a range. Capacity: the title and single on-bike photo both show ONE bag, no pair-volume language found, so 12L is treated as the single-bag rating (unlike the Arkel GT-54/Dolphin/Orca cases in this same pass, which WERE pair-volume mismatches).

geometry.notes: Flap-top pannier, drawstring collar under an outer flap, single vertical webbing strap with a side-release buckle down the front face. A vertically-textured hexagon-ribstop panel low on the front-right may be a stretch/mesh side pocket, but this is not clearly resolvable from the available 3/4-angle photo - kept thin rather than guessed.

closure.hardware: drawstring collar under an outer flap secured by a single front webbing strap and side-release buckle

straps.note: detachable shoulder strap per maker copy

pockets.note: inferred from a textured panel on the front-right in the on-bike photo, not confidently resolved - low confidence

details.fabric: 100% recycled 600D polyester with PU coating, Hexagon ribstop with PU coating - matches brands.json's base Greensphere clause (not the Extreme/TPU-welded clause, which does not apply to this product); see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: KLICKfix Vario Top hooks, o8-16mm rack tube range. clearance figures are estimates, not measured off a photo with a scale reference.

products.name: AGU Urban Essentials DWR Pannier 17L
products.dims_raw: AGU product page: '30 x 39 x 15 centimetres' (W x H x D read, matching the existing catalogue mapping), 17 litres, 646g, max load 7kg. Product name itself is 'DWR SINGLE Bike Bag Urban' - explicitly a single (not pair) rating.
products.dims_note: Single figure, no range. Axis mapping confirmed by the on-bike photo: a tall portrait-format flap-top bag, clearly taller than it is wide, matching hgt(39) > len(30) > wid(15). Box 30x15x39 = 17.6L against 17L rated (ratio 1.03), a tight, clean reconciliation supporting this reading.

geometry.notes: Squared-off flap-top pannier that converts to a backpack/tote (removable/coverable shoulder straps). Domed flap lid with a top carry handle, single vertical front buckle strap, small reflective loop tab on the side.

closure.hardware: drawstring closure under the flap, secured by a front buckle strap

straps.note: removable, can be covered to convert the bag to backpack carry per maker copy

details.fabric: Green Sphere recycled water-repellent polyester with DWR coating - matches brands.json fabric string; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: KLICKfix Vario E-hooks, o6-16mm rack tube range. clearance figures are estimates, not measured off a photo with a scale reference.
